name: wafeq
description: Manage invoices, bills, expenses, payments, reports, and other accounting records in Wafeq.

interface.longDescription: Review and manage invoices, bills, expenses, contacts, inventory, payments, reports, and other accounting records in Wafeq. Each user signs in with their own Wafeq account, and Wafeq applies that user's permissions. Supported changes require confirmation before Wafeq applies them.
